title: Linx Eden Water Tool Adapter
description:
Eden male water pipe adapter, fits 14mm and 18mm glass, made of stainless steel.

INCLUDE:
1 x Eden Water Pipe Adapter (Male)

HOW TO USE:
Screw the Eden glass mouthpiece section (glass tube and its base) off the metal filter section. Screw the adapter on the Eden. Connect a water pipe (not included) to the adapter.

COMPATIBLE WITH:
Linx Eden
Linx Bubbler
